items.html: (To the question) And the third report (in Item 60) speaks of the aspect of the Gadlut of ZA, when the coupling is made in it itself. Hence it says that from the lower third of the Tifferet the Galgalta of ZA was made, and from the NHY of AA the three Mochin were made in it. For then it ascends and clothes even the two upper joints of the NHY that became the HGT of Aba and Ima, and they become in it its Hochma and Bina. And the upper third of the Yesod of AA becomes in it an upper Daat in the Rosh, that is, the place of the coupling, which brings out the ten Sefirot of the Rosh from below upward, as is known. And afterward it reverses and bestows from above downward, and brings out in it the ten Sefirot of the Guf. And this is what it says, that from the Yesod of Arich the rest of the entire Guf of ZA expanded. That is, after the Yesod of Arich became in it the phase of Daat, and brought out in ZA ten Sefirot from below upward, to the phase of a Rosh, it then reverses and bestows in it those same ten Sefirot also from above downward, and brings out in it ten Sefirot of the Guf; thus, from the Yesod of Arich, the entire Guf of ZA expanded.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 67:1
items.html: Regarding the relation of the Partzuf of Keter, whose phase is the first expansion called Ta'amim, Chesed-Gevura-Tiferet and Netzach-Hod of ZA are considered as Chochma-Bina-Da'at of ZON, and so the essence of ZA is found to be Netzach, and the Nukva is Hod. And Chesed-Gevura-Tiferet are like Chochma-Bina-Da'at. (Alef 32, entry beginning "and already").

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 68:1
items.html: (To the question) The Netzah of ZA is considered the essence of ZA from the aspect of the vessels, for the HGT are on account of its inclusion with what is above it, and Hod is on account of its inclusion with what is below it. For every Sefira is included of the ten Sefirot, on account of the inclusion with what is above it and with what is below it. As I wrote above, Part 2, in the Inner Observation, page 75, Chapter 9, see there.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 69:1
items.html: The Tifferet of ZA is considered his essence, from the aspect of the clothing of the lights in the vessels. For it is always drawn from the second expansion, which is the phase of AB, which is the first filling, to the Guf of the Partzuf of Keter, after its refinement, as is known. And in the Partzuf of AB the degrees descended, and KHB became HBD, and Tifferet became the phase of Netzah, which is the essence of ZA, as above in answer 141. (Page 33)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 70:1
items.html: The drawing of the vessels of ZA is attributed to the Partzuf of Keter of AK, for Keter is the phase of the principal and the root, from which all the discernments are drawn. And likewise, the phase of the AA of Atzilut is considered to receive from the phase of the AA of AK, for every phase in Atzilut receives from the phase opposite it in AK.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 71:1
items.html: The phase of the clothing of the lights in the vessels of ZA is drawn from the phase of the Partzuf of AB of AK, which is the second expansion, which filled the lights of the body of the Partzuf of Keter of AK after its refinement. Hence the clothing of the lights is not attributed to the Partzuf of Keter of AK, for in his body there was the refinement and departure of the lights, and nothing remained in him but the vessels alone; but the lights in the body of Keter came from AB, which is the second expansion, as is known. Thus both the lights and the vessels are always drawn from the Partzuf of Keter, which is the root of everything; only the vessels can be attributed to the Partzuf of Keter himself, for they remained also after the first departure, unlike the lights, of which there is no longer any aspect of the Partzuf of Keter there, for they departed at the time of the refinement, and all the lights clothed there are of AB.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 72:1
items.html: See answer 443 above.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 73:1
items.html: (To the question) The root of ZA, from the aspect of the ten Sefirot of AVI [upper Aba and Ima], you already know that from the aspect of the vessels it is Netzah, and from the aspect of the lights it is Tifferet, as above in Answer 146. However, from the aspect of the Partzufim, it has already been explained in the previous parts that it is the phase of the two lower thirds of the NH of AK, which at the time of the second restriction went out from the aspect of Atzilut to the phase of BYA; and afterward, through the ascent of the NHY of AK as MAN to AB SAG, and their receiving from there the new light that broke through to the Parsa, it returned and raised the two lower thirds of its NH from BYA to Atzilut, in the secret of a Vav and a point, which it bestowed upon Aba and Ima of the Nekudim, and Aba and Ima coupled upon them and brought them out in all the phases of Gadlut, which are the seven lower of the Nekudim that reigned and expanded down to the point of this world and broke. And afterward they returned and received correction through the ascent of the NHY to the HGT of AA, and through the couplings of Aba and Ima, which is the phase of the pregnancy of ZA, with which we are engaged in this part. Thus the root of ZA, from the aspect of the Partzufim, is not like its root from the aspect of the ten Sefirot, but rather it is from the phase of the two lower thirds of the NH of the Partzuf of the NHY of AK. And this has already been well explained in the previous parts. However, in truth, they have a close relation to one another, for even the ten Sefirot of the NHY of AK divide likewise into three thirds: KHB, HGT, NHY, in the manner that we explained above in the division of the NHY of AA of Atzilut. And as we explained above, that the essence of ZA is from the phase of the lower third of the Netzah of AA, and the Nukva is from the side of the lower third of the Hod of AA (see above, Answer 122), the same thing is likewise discerned in the NHY of AK: that the two lower thirds of the NH that went out to BYA at the time of the second restriction are the roots of ZON, with ZA in the lower third of Netzah, and the Nukva in the lower third of Hod. Thus the relations of AVI and the relations of the Partzufim always have an equal value.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 74:1
items.html: (To the question) The essence of ZON is the NH, and therefore they receive from the NH of AA. And the main correction of the three days of absorption is the phase of the correction of the lines, which comes through the association of the quality of mercy with judgment, as is known. And this is done through the ascent of the Yesod of AA to the Tifferet, which caused the inclusion of the NHY of ZA in its HGT, as is known. Hence it is discerned that ZA receives from the Tifferet and Yesod of AA, for from there comes all the correction of the three days of absorption, as explained. (Page 1034, beginning "And this").

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 75:1
items.html: Because the root of the Nukva is in the Hod of HGT NH of direct light, from the side of the vessels, as is known.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 76:1
items.html: From the aspect of the fixed Mochin in Atzilut — namely, from what AVI took of the SAG of MA — they are discerned as having complete ten Sefirot in all their need. However, their own phase of AVI is the phase of AB, and from that aspect they have only what they clothe upon HGT of AA, and they are lacking the NHY of the vessels and the GAR of the lights. (Page 35)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 77:1
items.html: (To the question) It is for the reason that for the need of the pregnancy of ZA, Aba and Ima must attain the stature of AB, and it is known that from the aspect of AB they have only VAK, as above in Answer 151; hence the VAK must be divided and made into ten Sefirot, like ZA at the time it must attain its Gadlut. For the upper and middle joints of the HGT become KHB, and the upper joints of the NHY ascend and become HGT, as is known. And then it is discerned that blood ascended and turned into milk. For the lights of the NHY are called blood, from the word "silence" [demama], since they are the phase of the Sefirot of the Sium, which silence the lights and do not allow them to expand further. And the lights of the HGT are called milk; hence, in the ascent of the NHY to the HGT, the blood ascended and became milk, and therefore the menstruation ceases immediately at the time of the pregnancy, for necessarily the two upper thirds of the NH ascended and became breasts of milk, as explained. (Page 826, column a, line 36, beginning "And behold").

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 78:1
items.html: (To the question) For the two upper thirds of the NH of AA ascended and became the phase of the HGT of Aba and Ima, and the phase of breasts, which are the phase of the Mochin of ZA, for the HGT of Aba and Ima became the Mochin of ZA, as is known. Hence it takes nothing of them at the time of the pregnancy, for then it has no Mochin, but is the phase of its head between its knees, for it has only the stature of NHY alone. Rather, at the time of the nursing it receives from them in the manner of an ascent, not permanently, which is called Mochin of nursing. And at the time of Gadlut it ascends and clothes them permanently, and they become the phase of its KHB, as is known. (Page 1036, beginning "Four joints").

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 79:1
items.html: For the HGT of the level of AB of AVI were made of two phases: of the three lower thirds that remained of the HGT of AA, and of the three upper thirds that ascended to them from the NHY of AA, as is known. And the Tifferet includes within it Hesed and Gevura; hence this Tifferet is called by the name of Vav, for the six phases mentioned above. And the Mochin of ZA are made not merely of the NHY of AA, but of the NHY that ascended and became HGT. We find that the three Mochin of ZA were made of the lower half of the Vav, namely of the three upper thirds of the NHY of AA that ascended and became HGT; and the upper half of the Vav, namely the three lower thirds of the HGT, remained as the phase of HGT, for the need of AVI themselves. (Item 58).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 80:1
items.html: The Yesod of AA at the time of the pregnancy could not ascend and become HGT together with the two upper thirds of the NH of AA, because of the screen of the Sium found above it, at the end of the Tifferet, as is known. Hence it is discerned as neither above, in the phase of Rosh, nor below, in the phase of VAK, for from the aspect of the MA, the screen of the Sium does not stand in the Tifferet but in the Yesod itself. Therefore, at the Gadlut of ZA it, too, ascends to the HGT, equally with the two upper thirds of the NH; only at the time of the pregnancy, when the phase of BON dwells upon it, the Yesod cannot ascend, as above. However, in any case it is not considered complete VAK, and hence it is called by the name of a tower flying in the air, meaning that it is neither of the phase of above nor of the phase of below, but as one flying. (Item 73).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 81:1
items.html: Just as the Yesod went out from the phase of the Rosh of ZA, namely that it cannot ascend to the HGT because of the screen standing above it, at the end of the Tifferet, so Bina went out of the Rosh of AA, because of the screen above her, in the Malchut of the Rosh of AA. Nevertheless, Bina is not considered complete VAK, like the body, but is considered the phase of the Garon and Rosh for AVI, as is known. Therefore she, too, is called a tower flying in the air, like the Yesod of AA, for she, too, is neither above, in the phase of the Rosh of AA, nor below, in the phase of the body of AA, like the Yesod — as above in Answer 155 — but she is as one flying in the air. (Item 75).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 82:1
items.html: Only during pregnancy is the Yesod of AA made into the Bina of ZA, for then his Sefirot are counted in the values of the Sefirot of AA. Also, the force of BON rests upon him, and therefore the Yesod went out outside the Rosh, which is the lower third of Tifferet, and that became the Rosh and Hochma of ZA. However, at the time of Gadlut, when he receives from MA, the Yesod can also rise to HGT, as above in answer 155. And therefore the Yesod then becomes the phase of Daat of ZA. (Item 75)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 83:1
items.html: See answer 13 above.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 84:1
items.html: In the state of three within three, as in the days of gestation. (Item 89)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 85:1
items.html: In the state of nursing. (Item 90)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 86:1
items.html: There are three phases in the kings that were broken: lights, sparks, and vessels. And at the time of correction, the vessels of the Mochin, which are the three hollows in the bone of the Galgalta, were clarified from the vessels of the kings; and the membranes of the Mochin were clarified from the sparks of the kings; and from their lights that remained in Atzilut, the refined flesh called Motin was made. Hence the membranes are phases of judgment and phases of the names of Elokim, since they come from the sparks of BYA. But the Mochin are phases of the names of HaVaYaH, which are mercy, since they come from the lights that never went out below the phases of Atzilut. Also, from the sparks, the phase of Nefesh was made for the external organs of the Partzuf, and from the lights, the phase of Nefesh was made for the internal organs of the Partzuf. And all this also applies in pregnancy and nursing. (Item 97).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 87:1
items.html: See answer 161.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 88:1
items.html: See answer 161.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 89:1
items.html: The Mochin are always names of HaVaYaH, even in the pregnancy and nursing. And what we said, that the Mochin of pregnancy and nursing are names of Elokim, the intention is only regarding the membranes of the Mochin, which are judgment. (Item 98).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 90:1
items.html: Bina and Tevuna are always discerned as separate Partzufim, for this is drawn from the Bina of the ten Sefirot of AVI themselves, which is discerned as two phases: one is its GAR, that is, before it emanated to the ZA of AVI, which is the phase of the light of Hassadim in the posteriors to the Hochma. And the second is the phase of its ZAT, which is from the time it emanated to the ZA of AVI, when it turned its face to the Hochma of AVI in order to bring the illumination of Hochma into ZA, as is known. And from this is drawn the necessity for every Partzuf that is in the stature of Bina, that it must be divided into GAR and ZAT, whose GAR is the phase of covered Hassadim, that is, without the illumination of Hochma. And its ZAT are in revealed Hassadim, that is, with the illumination of Hochma in the Hassadim.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 90:2
items.html: (To the question) However, at the time of the birth of ZA, Aba and Ima and Yeshsut return to the phase of a single Partzuf. And even this is only during the days of the pregnancy, but at the time of the birth of ZA they return and divide into two separate Partzufim. (Item 101. and Item 105).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 91:1
items.html: The Yesod of the general AVI and Yeshsut, when they become one Partzuf, is in the mouth of the Rosh and the filling of the HaVaYaH of SAG: Yud-Hey-Vav-Hey, which is Tevuna, clothing the lower third of the Tifferet of the upper AVI at the time they are two Partzufim. And in this Yesod the coupling of AVI is made upon the MAN of ZA, and there his Mochin came out, and from there he came out at the time he was born. (Item 102).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 92:1
items.html: (To the question) Behold, the coupling of the upper Aba and Ima never ceases at all, for it is to give life to the worlds, and were it to cease, the destruction of the worlds would immediately follow. And at the time of the birth of ZA, Aba and Ima must adapt their coupling to the need of the Mochin of the nursing of ZA, which is the phase of VAK. Hence there are two opposing actions here, that on the one hand Aba and Ima must be in a face-to-face coupling that does not cease, and on the other hand Aba and Ima must diminish to the phase of VAK, in order to clothe the Mochin in the phase of Katnut, in keeping with ZA at that time. Hence they divide again into two Partzufim, as at first before the pregnancy, so that Aba and Ima return to their phase in a face-to-face coupling that does not cease. And Yeshsut diminishes, in the secret of crouching, to the phase of VAK, in order to clothe the Mochin of the Katnut of ZA. (Item 105).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 93:1
items.html: See answer 167 above.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 94:1
items.html: (To the question) The meaning is not that the first Tevuna, which clothes the TNHY of the upper Aba and Ima, is made in the secret of crouching; rather, there are in the first Tevuna two phases: internality and externality. And the phase of the internality in it returns to its degree in the phase of GAR. And only the externality of this Tevuna descends and diminishes to the phase of crouching. Thus there are now three Tevunot, that is, three phases of Aba and Ima: the first is the upper Aba and Ima, which are from the Chazeh and above of AA. The second is Yeshsut, which clothes the TNHY of the upper Aba and Ima, from the phase of its internality, which is called the first Tevuna. The third is the externality of the first Tevuna, which descended in the phase of crouching, and is called the third Tevuna. Hence they are divided into KHB HGT NHY. (Item 105).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 95:1
items.html: See below, answer 171. (Item 119, and Item 129).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 96:1
items.html: The essence of the interpretation of the Mem of the Tzelem is the belly in general, which is the GAR and Rosh of the first Tevuna, from the aspect of her externality. However, at the time of the birth of ZA, these GAR descended to the phase of HGT, namely to the phase of crouching, as is known. And afterwards, at the time of the Gadlut of ZA, these HGT are destined to return and become GAR. Hence these HGT, which include HGT KHB, are discerned as such, and therefore the ARI says that the Mem of the Tzelem includes the first six Sefirot of Tevuna. However, at present, in Katnut, they are only HGT alone, as explained. And for the same reason, it is possible to say that the Mem of the Tzelem is the first four of Tevuna, for at the time of Gadlut these HGT become the phase of GAR.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 96:2
items.html: And afterwards there is a second descent, that they descend to the phase of the Lamed of the Tzelem, namely they descend from the phase of the HGT of Tevuna to the NHY of Tevuna. And these NHY, too, may be called HGT on the name of the future, for in Gadlut they are destined to be HGT, as they were before the birth of ZA. (Item 105, and Item 114, and Item 119, and Item 129).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 97:1
items.html: The essence of the Tzelem is drawn and formed from the upper AVI, at the time when they are one Partzuf with Yeshsut. For the Tzelem is the phase of the reflected light that rises at the time of the coupling from below upward, and clothes the ten Sefirot of direct light. And at the time of the coupling, AVI and Yeshsut must be one Partzuf, and then Yeshsut is not considered by name, but AVI alone. (Item 119)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 98:1
items.html: The Tzelem is formed in the womb of Aba and Ima when they are in a state of oneness together with Yisrael-Saba and Tevuna, and this place is considered the phase of the head of Yisrael-Saba and Tevuna when they are separated from Aba and Ima. And it is called by the name Rechem [womb], where ZA stands during his pregnancy. (Item 119).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 99:1
items.html: The Daat of ZA is drawn from the two shoulders of AA, which are the phase of the lower thirds of the Hesed and Gevura of AA. For the Hochma of ZA is drawn from the Hochma of AVI, which are the upper joints of the arms of AA; the Bina of ZA is drawn from the Bina of AVI, which are the middle joints of the arms of AA; and the Daat of ZA is drawn from the ZAT of AVI, which are the lower joints of the arms of AA, called the shoulders. And it is so, for the hand joined with the fingers is considered the upper joint of the arms, the forearm is the middle joint, and the shoulder is the lower joint. (Page 1067, Item 121).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 100:1
items.html: When the Mochin descend to the Yesodot of AVI for the sake of ZA, two discernments are distinguished in them: Yesod and Atara. GAR of the Mochin, which are HB, clothe in the Yesodot themselves of AVI, and ZAT of the Mochin, which are Daat, clothe in their Atarot of AVI: its right half, which is Hesed, clothes in Aba, and its left half, which is Gevura, clothes in the Atara of Ima. And because the two halves of Daat clothe in the two Atarot of AVI, they are therefore called the two Atarin. (Page 1068, Item 122).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 101:1
items.html: At the time of attaining the Mochin of ZA, the third Tevuna returns to being GAR, and then it too divides into Samekh and Mem, like AVI and Yeshsut. Its first six Sefirot, which are from the Chazeh and above, are called Samekh, and they are in covered Hassadim, like AVI Ilain. And its NHY, which are from the Chazeh and below, are called closed Mem, and they are in revealed Hassadim, like Yeshsut.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 101:2
items.html: And you already know that the first six Sefirot of the third Tevuna are called the Mem of Tzelem, and this is because they contain four Mochin: HB, and Hesed and Gevura. For the two Atarin, which are the two halves of Daat, do not couple with one another so as to raise the reflected light up to HB and reveal the Hassadim in the illumination of Hochma, since they have no matter for revealing Hochma, being in the discernment of covered Hassadim, and therefore the two halves of Daat are discerned as two separate Mochin. Hence they are discerned as four Mochin: HB and HG.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 101:3
items.html: But the NHY of the third Tevuna, which are called the Lamed of Tzelem — the discernment of Yeshsut and the closed Mem, whose way is in revealed Hassadim — here the two halves of Daat couple with one another to raise the reflected light up to HB, so as to bring the illumination of Hochma outward and reveal the Hassadim. Thus the two halves of Daat, which are Hesed and Gevura, are found returning to being one Mochin. For they are obliged to couple and join with one another, in order to reveal the illumination of Hochma in the Hassadim, and therefore it is called Lamed, since here there are only three Mochin, namely: Hochma, Bina, Daat, for Hesed and Gevura became one Mochin, as explained (Item 127).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 102:1
items.html: Behold, the externality of the Rechem, in the whole of AVI and Yeshsut, which is the Rosh of the first Tevuna, where the Mochin of ZA emerge from the coupling of AVI, is called the Mem of Tzelem. At the birth of ZA it diminished to the discernment of VAK, called crouching, and its GAR became HGT, as is known. Therefore these HGT also include GAR within them, since they came from the discernment of GAR — for during the pregnancy it was in the discernment of GAR, and also afterward, at the Gadlut of ZA, it is destined to return to the discernment of GAR. It is therefore discerned as the first six Sefirot of this Tevuna, namely KHB HGT up to the Chazeh. And it is discerned as Avir [air], meaning the light of Ruach, which is the light of Hassadim. There are two reasons for this: either from the time of Katnut, when it descended to the discernment of VAK, which is the light of Ruach; or from the time of Gadlut, when the illumination of Hochma is still withheld from them, since they are the discernment of AVI Ilain, which are from the Chazeh and above (as above, in Answer 176), being in covered Hassadim, and are therefore called by the name Avir even then. And they are also called by the name Hochma, since at the time of Gadlut they are destined to become the discernment of AVI Ilain, which are called Hochma. For this reason it is called the Yud of HaVaYaH, since AVI Ilain are the discernment of the Yud of HaVaYaH, as is known, for Aba is the Yud, and Upper Ima is the filling of Vav-Dalet in the filling of Yud. And it is also called Tzelem, since it is the root in which the lower letters are included, and therefore the Lamed and the Tzadi too are included in the Mem. (Item 127).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 103:1
items.html: The Lamed of Tzelem is the NHY of the third Tevuna, for before the Mochin of ZA descend to clothe in these NHY, they are not yet fit to expand into ZA, since while they are clothed in the HGT of Tevuna, which is the Mem of Tzelem, they are in covered Hassadim, and the whole essence of ZA needs revealed Hassadim, as is known. They must therefore make a second descent to the NHY of Tevuna, which are destined, at the time of Gadlut, to become the discernment of Yeshsut in revealed Hassadim, as above in Answer 176. For this reason it is also called the first Hey of HaVaYaH, since the first Hey is Yeshsut, and HaVaYaH of SAG, as is known. It is therefore also called Bina, since the whole of AVI Ilain is called Hochma, and the whole of Yeshsut is called Bina, as is known. It is also the discernment of light that remained from Avir, for the matter of the Katnut of the third Tevuna came about through the rising of the bottom Hey to the Einayim, which is the secret of the Yud that entered into the discernment of the light of GAR and became Avir — meaning that it descended to the discernment of VAK and the light of Ruach. Now it is found that at the time of Gadlut, through the illumination of the coupling of the upper AB SAG, the bottom Hey descended from the Einayim, and the third Tevuna returned to being GAR; so the Yud again descended from Avir and returned to being light as before. This is why it is hinted at as the discernment of light that remained from Avir. But AVI Ilain, who are the discernment of the Mem of Tzelem, remain in the discernment of Avir even at Gadlut, since they are in the secret of “for He delights in mercy,” and do not reveal the discernment of the illumination of Hochma in the Hassadim, as above in Answer 177. It is therefore also called “a tower flying in the air,” meaning that sometimes, through the sin of the lower ones, the Yud returns and enters into the light, and becomes Avir again, and sometimes the Yud goes out from Avir and returns to being light. This is like something flying in the air. And it is the discernment of the Tzadi-Lamed of Tzelem, since it includes within it the Tzadi below it, but not the Mem above it, and therefore it lacks the Mem of Tzelem, and likewise it lacks the Yud of Avir — meaning, the discernment of the Avir of AVI Ilain, since the Yud of the Avir of AVI Ilain is permanently fixed there, both at Gadlut and at Katnut, and is considered there to be the discernment of complete GAR, being from the Chazeh and above, in the discernment of the GAR of Bina, where the illumination of Hochma does not apply, because of “for He delights in mercy.” This is not so with the Yud of the Avir of the Lamed of Tzelem, which are the discernment of Yeshsut, who need the illumination of Hochma; there the Yud that entered into the light and makes it into Avir — this Avir lacks GAR, since it needs the illumination of Hochma. Thus the power of the bottom Hey rules over it, as is known. And this is what is meant by saying that the Yud is lacking from Avir, namely the Yud of the Mem of Tzelem, which is always complete GAR — this does not apply in the Lamed of Tzelem, as explained. (Item 128; and Item 135; and Item 56).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 104:1
items.html: For the emergence of the Mochin of ZA is in a very high place, since they emerge in the place of the Rosh of Yeshsut, when it is joined with AVI into a single Partzuf. Therefore, in order to fit them for the reception of ZA, they must diminish through two descents: the first, that at the time of birth, after the externality of Yeshsut becomes HGT, they descend from the discernment of GAR to HGT, which is the Mem of Tzelem. But even from here the Mochin are not yet fit for ZA, since there is the discernment of a place of covered Hassadim, for at the time of Gadlut they become the discernment of AVI Ilain, as above, in Answer 178. Therefore they need a second descent, namely to the Lamed of Tzelem, which is the place of revealed Hassadim, fit for ZA. However, even from this Lamed they do not receive from its internality, but only from its externality, and this externality is called by the name the Tzadi of Tzelem. (Item 128).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 105:1
items.html: For the Mem of Tzelem is the discernment of the Yud of HaVaYaH, which is the discernment of AVI Ilain, as is known, and Upper Ima is the discernment of the filling of Vav-Dalet of the Yud, and she is called by the name Ehyeh. But the Lamed of Tzelem, which is the discernment of Yeshsut, is the discernment of the first Hey of HaVaYaH, since Tevuna is the discernment of HaVaYaH of SAG and not the discernment of Ehyeh. Therefore the name Ehyeh is concealed from the Lamed of Tzelem. (Item 132).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 106:1
items.html: It is known that the filling of Yudin alludes to the first Tzimtzum, and the filling of Alfin alludes to the second Tzimtzum, which comes about through the rising of the bottom Hey to the Einayim. You also know that, regarding the GAR of Bina, which are the discernment of AVI Ilain, the rising of the bottom Hey to the Einayim does not bring it down to the discernment of VAK, since it does not need the illumination of Hochma in any case; and therefore it is in the secret of Avira Dachya [pure air], meaning that its Avir too is the discernment of GAR. However, all this is from the Chazeh and above of Tevuna, which is the Mem of Tzelem. But from the Chazeh and below, which is the discernment of the Lamed of Tzelem, and is the discernment of Yeshsut, which needs the illumination of Hochma, the bottom Hey that rose to the Einayim makes them into the discernment of VAK, since the power of the bottom Hey rules over them, and therefore they have the filling of Alfin. This is not so with AVI Ilain, from the Chazeh and above, where there is only the filling of Yudin, since the power of the bottom Hey in the Einayim, which is the secret of the second Tzimtzum, does not rule over them. Thus the filling of Alfin begins only with the Lamed of Tzelem. However, the name Ehyeh is concealed from it, since there is no Ehyeh except in Upper Ima, as is known. (Item 132).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 107:1
items.html: The three letters Tzadi-Lamed-Mem [Tzelem] are three descents of the Mochin from the place of their emergence, which is the belly of AVI, until their arrival within the internality of ZA. The first descent is the descent of the GAR of Yeshsut, which are the discernment of the belly, to the discernment of VAK, and it is then called the Mem of Tzelem. In this clothing, however, they are not yet fit to expand into ZA, being in the discernment of covered Hassadim, as above in Answer 179. They therefore descend a second descent, to the NHY of this Tevuna, called the Lamed of Tzelem, where there is the place of revealed Hassadim, and from here they are fit to clothe in ZA. However, the lower one receives not from the internality of the upper one but only from its externality, as is known; and therefore the externality of this Lamed descends and expands together with the Mochin into ZA, and this externality is called the Tzadi of Tzelem, discerned as the third descent.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 107:2
items.html: And this Tzadi is also called by the name Daat, meaning, the Daat that expands into ZA. For in the Lamed of Tzelem the Mochin are found in the discernment of from below upward, which is the discernment of a Rosh, but here, in the Tzadi, they descend and expand from above downward within ZA, and fill all his halls and chambers, as is known. It is therefore called the Vav of HaVaYaH, since in it is the discernment of the expansion into ZA, which is called Vav. And Vav is also the secret of Daat. Thus the Mem is the Yud of HaVaYaH, the Lamed is the Hey of HaVaYaH, and the Tzadi is the Vav of HaVaYaH. And they are the discernment of Habad, as explained. Yod-Hey, which are the Mem and the Lamed, are the discernment of surrounding lights, since they did not expand into the internality of ZA, as above. But the Tzadi is the discernment of internal Mochin, since it is what expands into the internality of ZA. (Item 137).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 108:1
items.html: For the Mochin of Hochma-Bina are closed, meaning that Hochma does not illuminate to Bina, so that Bina could reveal the illumination of Hochma to ZA. And they do not develop except through Daat, as the Rav wrote (in item 151), see there. For through the coupling of Hesed-Gevura that is in Daat, the reflected light rises up to Hochma, and brings its illumination outward to Bina, and thus the light of Hochma is first received in the reflected light rising from Daat, and according to the measure of that reflected light, so is the illumination of Hochma it receives — if it is from phase Bet, its reception is found to be small, and if it is from phase Gimel, its reception is found to be great. As the Rav wrote in Mavo Shearim, Gate 5, Part 1, Chapter 9, and this is his language: "And thus it is found, that the drop of light descending from the mind called Hochma, through Daat, to Bina, is the stone weighed in Daat, to know whether it is heavy or light." And thus the phase of the light and the phase of the weighing have been explained, as they are being drawn from Hochma to Bina through Daat, see there the whole continuation. Thus the receiver from Hochma is the reflected light rising from Daat, and through Daat it is bestowed to Bina, and ZA receives the illumination of Hochma from Bina, since it is the emanator of ZA, as is known. However, this too is through Daat, namely, that in the same measure by which the reflected light rises from below upward and reveals the illumination of Hochma to Bina, so does this reflected light again expand from above downward, into ZA. And this is why the Rav orders here the Mochin of ZA in the order MaTzaL, that first is Hochma, and then Daat, and then Bina. (Item 139)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 109:1
items.html: The matter of the Tzelem — its meaning is a garment of the Mochin, and it is the phase of the reflected light rising at the time of the coupling from below upward and clothing the direct light. For the direct light is the essence of the Mochin, and the reflected light is what clothes them. Now, this coupling for the sake of the Mochin of ZA is made in Aba ve Ima, at the time when they are joined with Yeshsut in a single Partzuf. And then Yeshsut are nullified in relation to Aba ve Ima and do not rise in name for themselves, as is known. Therefore the Tzelem is discerned as emerging and formed from the phase of Havayah-Ehyeh, which are the names of Aba ve Ima Ilain, and thus this reflected light that is the phase of the Tzelem emerged from the screen and coarseness of the phase of the Partzuf of Ima Ila'ah, which is the name Ehyeh. Therefore the Rav says that the three Yuds in the name Ehyeh are hinted at in the Lamed of Tzelem, for from there it is formed, as explained. (Item 136 and item 141)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 110:1
items.html: The change is in the measure of the screen and coarseness that Aba ve Ima arouse in themselves, at the time they couple upon the Mayin Nukvin of ZA. For example, at the time of the first gestation, Aba ve Ima arouse the phase of the screen of the externality of themselves, where there is only the level of Nefesh. And in the phase of nursing they arouse the phase of the screen of phase Aleph within themselves, in which there is a level of the light of Ruach, this screen coming from their middle vessels. And in the phase of Gadlut they arouse in themselves the phase of the screen of phase Bet, in which there is a level of Neshama, which they arouse from their inner vessels. Therefore, the phase of the Tzelem of gestation is the phase of Nefesh in an outer vessel. And the phase of the Tzelem of nursing is the phase of Ruach in a middle vessel. And the phase of the Tzelem of Gadlut is the phase of Neshama in an inner vessel. (Item 144 and 145)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 111:1
items.html: Also the Mochin of ZA divide into the phase of Aba ve Ima Ilain and Yeshsut, like the general Aba ve Ima. For Hochma-Bina of ZA are the phase of Aba ve Ima in covered Hassadim, and Aba does not bestow his illumination to Bina. Therefore Hochma-Bina of ZA are clothed in Netzah-Hod of Aba ve Ima, which are phases of extremities between which there is no coupling, and therefore they are closed, since Aba does not bestow to Bina. But the Daat of ZA, which is the phase of Yeshsut and revealed Hassadim, is clothed in the Yesodot of Aba ve Ima, where there is a place of coupling, and they couple and bring forth the illumination of Hochma outward and it is bestowed to Bina, and thus the Hassadim are found revealed in the illumination of Hochma, as above in answer 183, see there. Therefore only the mind of Daat is discerned as revealed. (And item 151)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 112:1
items.html: This growth of Daat is in the secret of the reflected light that is raised by the upper light striking upon the coarseness in its Gevurot, which is the secret of the screen in the vessel of Malchut of the head, so that the reflected light rising from below upward is what clothes and measures the level of the direct light, as is known, and with this it also enlarges Hochma-Bina, even though they are above, as is the custom in all couplings. (Item 152)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 113:1
items.html: For there is the phase of the screen and the coarseness with which the upper light couples and raises reflected light. As above in Answer 183; see there. And therefore it is that which enlarges and measures the measure of the Mochin. (There)
